message:
Command `python3 << 'PYEND'
with open('/app/src/sql/parser/parser.rs', 'a') as f:
    f.write('    fn parse_expression(&mut self) -> Result<ast::Expression> {\n')
    f.write('        self.parse_precedence(0)\n')
    f.write('    }\n\n')
    f.write('    fn parse_precedence(&mut self, min_precedence: u8) -> Result<ast::Expression> {\n')
    f.write('        let mut lhs = self.parse_primary()?;\n')
    f.write('        loop {\n')
    f.write('            let Some(token) = self.peek()? else {\n')
    f.write('                break;\n')
    f.write('            };\n')
    f.write('            let (precedence, is_right_associative) = match token {\n')
    f.write('                Token::Keyword(Keyword::And) => (5, false),\n')
    f.write('                Token::Keyword(Keyword::Or) => (1, false),\n')
    f.write('                Token::Equal | Token::NotEqual | Token::LessThan | Token::LessThanOrEqual | Token::GreaterThan | Token::GreaterThanOrEqual | Token::Keyword(Keyword::Like) => (3, false),\n')
    f.write('                Token::Keyword(Keyword::Is) => (4, true),\n')
    f.write('                Token::Plus | Token::Minus => (6, false),\n')
    f.write('                Token::Asterisk | Token::Slash | Token::Percent => (7, false),\n')
    f.write('                Token::Caret => (8, true),\n')
    f.write('                Token::Exclamation => (9, false),\n')
    f.write('                _ => break,\n')
    f.write('            };\n')
    f.write('            if precedence < min_precedence {\n')
    f.write('                break;\n')
    f.write('            }\n')
    f.write('            self.next();\n')
    f.write('            if precedence == 9 {\n')
    f.write('                lhs = ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Factorial(Box::new(lhs)));\n')
    f.write('                continue;\n')
    f.write('            }\n')
    f.write('            let rhs = if is_right_associative {\n')
    f.write('                self.parse_precedence(precedence)?\n')
    f.write('            } else {\n')
    f.write('                self.parse_precedence(precedence + 1)?\n')
    f.write('            };\n')
    f.write('            lhs = match token {\n')
    f.write('                Token::Keyword(Keyword::And) => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::And(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs))),\n')
    f.write('                Token::Keyword(Keyword::Or) => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Or(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs))),\n')
    f.write('                Token::Equal => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Equal(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs))),\n')
    f.write('                Token::NotEqual => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::NotEqual(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs))),\n')
    f.write('                Token::LessThan => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::LessThan(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs))),\n')
    f.write('                Token::LessThanOrEqual => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::LessThanOrEqual(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs))),\n')
    f.write('                Token::GreaterThan => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::GreaterThan(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs))),\n')
    f.write('                Token::GreaterThanOrEqual => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::GreaterThanOrEqual(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs))),\n')
    f.write('                Token::Keyword(Keyword::Like) => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Like(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs))),\n')
    f.write('                Token::Keyword(Keyword::Is) => {\n')
    f.write('                    let literal = match self.next()? {\n')
    f.write('                        Token::Keyword(Keyword::Null) => ast::Literal::Null,\n')
    f.write('                        Token::Keyword(Keyword::NaN) => ast::Literal::Float(f64::NAN),\n')
    f.write('                        Token::Keyword(Keyword::Infinity) => ast::Literal::Float(f64::INFINITY),\n')
    f.write('                        other => return errinput!("expected NULL or NaN after IS, got {}", other),\n')
    f.write('                    };\n')
    f.write('                    ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Is(Box::new(lhs), literal))\n')
    f.write('                }\n')
    f.write('                Token::Plus => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Add(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs))),\n')
    f.write('                Token::Minus => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Subtract(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs))),\n')
    f.write('                Token::Asterisk => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Multiply(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs))),\n')
    f.write('                Token::Slash => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Divide(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs))),\n')
    f.write('                Token::Percent => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Remainder(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs))),\n')
    f.write('                Token::Caret => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Exponentiate(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs))),\n')
    f.write('                _ => break,\n')
    f.write('            };\n')
    f.write('        }\n')
    f.write('        Ok(lhs)\n')
    f.write('    }\n\n')
print('Part 6 done')
PYEND` executed with exit code 0.
